# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** fourteen  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Charlotta wears her hair in numerous braids wound around her head. The ends of these braids are tied up with white thread and stick out in all directions.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0022)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who displays genuine concern for her mistress. She is deeply devoted to her mistress's well-being and overall condition.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

Charlotta the Fourth served as a helper to Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at her secluded home, [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). While picking wild strawberries with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), Charlotta confided her concerns about Miss Lavendar's listlessness and recent change in behavior. Later, Charlotta helped [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepare a nervous Miss Lavendar for the arrival of her long-lost love, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and witnessed their happy reunion from the kitchen. In the following weeks, Charlotta assisted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) with the preparations leading up to Miss Lavendar and Stephen's garden wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +223 more_

## Quotes

> "it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> "I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?"
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "Yes, ma’am. Come in, ma’am. I’ll tell Miss Lavendar you’re here, ma’am. She’s upstairs, ma’am."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlotta.md)

Charlotta admires [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and strives to imitate her. The two first met when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for tea, and their bond grew during subsequent visits. Charlotta trusts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enough to confide her concerns regarding Miss Lavendar's listless behavior, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to offer her support and help prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for major life events.

- Friend of — admires her and strives to imitate her  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Charlotta knows [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) as a welcoming visitor at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). They first met when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally arrived at the cottage and were invited inside for tea. Charlotta later works alongside [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) when she comes to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to assist with the preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding.

- Friend of — welcoming visitor at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta works as the young handmaiden for Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Deeply devoted to her employer, Charlotta assists with household duties and hostessing, while also attentively worrying over Miss Lavendar's emotional wellbeing and changes in behavior. She works closely to support Miss Lavendar through her reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and her eventual wedding.

- Serves under — employer of little handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
